grid=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in test_text.splitlines()]

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # uniformly colored full separator lines
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=0]
    rblocks=[]; prev=0
    for r in rs+[h]:
        if r>prev:rblocks.append((prev,r))
        prev=r+1
    cblocks=[]; prev=0
    for c in cs+[w]:
        if c>prev:cblocks.append((prev,c))
        prev=c+1
    # each cell's predominant nonzero color and local bitmap
    cells={}
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(rblocks):
      for j,(x,y) in enumerate(cblocks):
        vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y) if grid[r][c]!=0]
        if vals:
          color=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
          cells[i,j]=(color,[[grid[r][c] for c in range(x,y)] for r in range(a,b)])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import defaultdict
    by=defaultdict(list)
    for pos,(color,bitmap) in cells.items():by[color].append(pos)
    for color,positions in by.items():
      if len(positions)!=3: continue
      minr,maxr=min(i for i,j in positions),max(i for i,j in positions)
      minc,maxc=min(j for i,j in positions),max(j for i,j in positions)
      if maxr-minr!=1 or maxc-minc!=1:continue
      missing={(i,j) for i in range(minr,maxr+1) for j in range(minc,maxc+1)}-set(positions)
      if len(missing)!=1:continue
      mr,mc=next(iter(missing)); sr,sc=(minr+maxr-mr,minc+maxc-mc)
      source=cells[sr,sc][1]
      ra,rb=rblocks[mr]; ca,cb=cblocks[mc]
      for dr in range(min(rb-ra,len(source))):
       for dc in range(min(cb-ca,len(source[dr]))):
        if source[len(source)-1-dr][len(source[dr])-1-dc]!=0:
         out[ra+dr][ca+dc]=color
    return out
result=transform(grid)
print(len(result),len(result[0]))
